project_overview.archetype_customer: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Playful - Expensive, deep, vibrant accents

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.

general.padding: Generous spacing philosophy (p-8 to p-12 for containers)
general.alignment: Left-align dense content/forms; Center-align hero moments in games.

management_grid.rules: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-6. Strict hierarchy, no empty gaps, functional. Sidebar for navigation.

customer_grid.rules: Asymmetrical, gap-8 to gap-12, heavily visual. Uses negative space for focus on games.

management.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Hover states lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
management.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar, highly scannable, F-pattern layout.

customer.surfaces: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10).
customer.buttons: Neumorphic or glowing edges with Framer Motion hover effects.
customer.modals: Crystal glass effect, heavily blurred background (backdrop-blur-2xl).

slot_machine.physics: Spring animation: type='spring', stiffness=80, damping=15, mass=1.2
slot_machine.mechanics: Simulate inertia with negative start or overshoot. Use staggerChildren: 0.3 to stagger reel stops sequentially. Use repeat symbols (20+) in column and animate translateY for seamless scroll.

card_games_war_pikapokeri.deal: Framer Motion layout animations. Cards translate from a fixed deck origin point.
card_games_war_pikapokeri.flip: 3D rotateY(180deg) transition using Framer Motion with backface-visibility: hidden.
card_games_war_pikapokeri.wins_loss: Particle effects via tsparticles or framer-motion explosions. Highlight winning paylines with glowing overlays.

testing_guidelines.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='spin-button', data-testid='deal-button'.
testing_guidelines.qa_focus: Regression testing for payout logic and state transitions, ensure game engine RTP remains fair during animation lags. Frame-rate testing on animations.

images.description: Dark moody casino background with abstract 3d shapes and neon lights. Use as the base wallpaper behind the game areas.
Luxurious geometric deep indigo and gold card back for WAR and Pikapokeri.
Modern dark brushed metal frame for the slot machine UI.
Casino chips for onboarding flow or decoration.

icons.library: lucide-react (default) and @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes. For fonts, ensure they are imported via Google/CDN links in index.css.
Implement the Management dashboard in pure HTML/Tailwind with Shadcn for complex forms. Keep it completely separated from the Customer side layout.
Customer side must use Dark mode exclusively. Avoid standard generic borders; use glassmorphism with high saturation.
Slot machine must NOT use random intervals alone. Calculate the final state first, then spin the reels using Framer Motion to land exactly on the required offset.
Do NOT alter the game logic/payout RTP rules, focus strictly on making the visual and animation layers wrapper around the deterministic logic.
Ensure all actions (spin, bet, deal) have 'data-testid' and disabled states during animations.
